name: decision
description: One investment judgement or decision as written in the source (buy, hold, wait, exit, rule change, roster change), with its date. The text is the source's own words.

source_key.description: Import key (source file + position, e.g. paper:<code>:tranche1:buy). The same key is the same record: re-running the import never adds it twice.

security_id.description: The security it is about; empty for portfolio-wide decisions.

security_ids.description: Securities a portfolio-wide decision applies to, when the source lists them.

decided_at.description: Date of the decision as stated by the source.

topic.description: The source's own label for the note (e.g. user_decision, exit_decision, exit_plan, observe_hold, tranche_order, roster_closed).

decided_by.description: user: the source text says the user decided (사용자 판단/결정/지시). Empty when the text does not say.

text.description: The decision in the source's words (structured notes as their JSON text).

relations.note: Decisions explain trades; how many times something was bought or sold is counted from trade, not decision.
